from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

with TemporaryDirectory() as carpeta:
    base = Path(carpeta)
    import py_compile
    ruta=base/"demo.py"
    ruta.write_text("print(2+3)\n",encoding="utf-8")
    py_compile.compile(str(ruta),cfile=str(base/"demo.pyc"),doraise=True)

Determinar la salida del siguiente código Python, con los datos incluidos.

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

with TemporaryDirectory() as carpeta:
    base = Path(carpeta)
    import subprocess,sys
    ruta=base/"demo.py"
    ruta.write_text("print(2+3)\n",encoding="utf-8")
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ruta)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    print(r.stdout,end="")
